Workload_Assumptions.Target_Workload: Simultaneous 64-Node K8s Pod Scale-Out Loading 140 GB Model Weights + 18 GB CUDA/vLLM Container Image

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Model Weights Baked Inside Monolithic `158 GB` OCI Container Image + Central Registry Pull + Tar Gunzip
Configuration_Matrix.Distribution_And_Loading: 64 Nodes Pull 10.1 TB from Central Registry + Sequential Single-Core `tar.gz` Extraction + `.bin` Pickle Load
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Catastrophic anti-pattern: 22.5-minute cold start and node ephemeral disk exhaustion

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Decoupled `18 GB` Image + Shared NFS/S3 Download + Legacy `torch.load(.bin)` CPU Deserialization
Configuration_Matrix.Distribution_And_Loading: Central Image Pull (110s) + 64-Node Concurrent NFS Read + Double Copy (Storage -> CPU RAM -> Pinned -> GPU)
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Legacy separated storage setup bottlenecked by Python pickle CPU deserialization and registry bandwidth

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: `Dragonfly / Spegel` P2P Image Distribution + Local NVMe Cached `.safetensors` Zero-Copy `mmap`
Configuration_Matrix.Distribution_And_Loading: P2P Block Distribution + `.safetensors` Header-First `mmap` into Host Page Cache
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Standard cloud K8s clusters without GPUDirect Storage (`cuFile`) or RDMA weight broadcast

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: `Nydus / eStargz` Lazy P2P Container Start (`4.2s`) + `Run:ai Model Streamer / NVIDIA GDS` + NCCL RDMA Leader-to-Peer Weight Broadcast
Configuration_Matrix.Distribution_And_Loading: On-Demand Chunk Fetch + 1-Node Storage Read -> 400GbE RDMA Tree Broadcast Directly into 64-Node GPU HBM (`6.8s`)
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Production gold standard for 64–1,024 node elastic vLLM/training clusters (11.0s total 64-node cold start, 122x faster)
